tokens.name: q-parch
tokens.usage: Questlog's page ground: body, app shell, sheets, toasts, notes. Written in code as color-mix(oklch, accent-100 78%, accent-300); this is its resolved value.

tokens.name: q-parch-2
tokens.usage: Deeper parchment: portrait fill. Resolved from color-mix(oklch, accent-100 52%, accent-300).

tokens.name: q-ink
tokens.usage: Body text and titles on q-parch (12.1:1) and color-accent-100 (13:1).

tokens.name: q-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and panel borders on parchment (ink at 18%). Separation is drawn with this, not with shadows.

tokens.name: q-wax
tokens.usage: Wax red: seals, the FAB, Crisis, overdue dates, danger buttons, the active tab marker, today's date. Text on q-parch 6.8:1; color-accent-100 on wax 7.3:1.

tokens.name: q-wax-hi
tokens.usage: Highlight stop of the wax-seal radial gradient (q-wax-hi → q-wax). Never text (3.6:1).

tokens.name: q-moss
tokens.usage: Forest green: completion — ticked checkboxes, the Complete button, done banners, habit dots, size S. Text on q-parch 6.1:1.

tokens.name: q-tint
tokens.usage: Selected state fill: pressed chips, current nav item, selected day/option (accent-300 at 35%).

tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Classical's neutral page ground; Questlog replaces it with q-parch.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Classical dialog surface.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Classical body text on color-bg (14.7:1).

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Classical accent: links, focus ring, .btn-primary. Fails as text on parchment (2.9:1) — Questlog uses the .inked modifier (color-accent-700) on parchment instead.

tokens.name: color-accent-2
tokens.usage: Classical second accent (tags).

tokens.name: color-divider
tokens.usage: Classical hairline (text at 16%): rules, inputs, segmented controls, cards.

tokens.name: color-accent-100
tokens.usage: Light ink on wax, moss and wood (seal glyphs, FAB label, tile text); faint panel fill.

tokens.name: color-accent-200
tokens.usage: Sidebar and campaign-column wash.

tokens.name: color-accent-300
tokens.usage: Hover washes and selection tint base; Main Quests zone light on the wood board.

tokens.name: color-accent-400

tokens.name: color-accent-500
tokens.usage: Pill and stat-pill borders; XP-bar fill; inner ring of portraits. Never text (2.5:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-600
tokens.usage: Bar outlines, title-input underline, focused quick-add border (3.7:1 on parchment: borders only).

tokens.name: color-accent-700
tokens.usage: Kickers, labels, nav items, links, inked primary buttons, Main Quests color. Text on q-parch 5.7:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-800
tokens.usage: Muted text, meta lines, icon buttons, wood board base. Text on q-parch 8.7:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-900

tokens.name: zone-crisis
tokens.usage: Crisis (urgent · important, ×1.25): zone color on parchment.

tokens.name: zone-crisis-light
tokens.usage: Crisis zone head and top border on the wood board (4.2:1 on accent-800 wood — fine at the 19px+ semibold zone heading, short for smaller text).

tokens.name: zone-main
tokens.usage: Main Quests (important · not urgent, ×1.5): zone color on parchment.

tokens.name: zone-main-light
tokens.usage: Main Quests zone head on the wood board (6.8:1).

tokens.name: zone-errand
tokens.usage: Errands (urgent · not important, ×0.8): zone color on parchment (6.3:1).

tokens.name: zone-errand-light
tokens.usage: Errands zone head on the wood board (4.9:1).

tokens.name: zone-side
tokens.usage: Side Quests (neither, ×0.6): zone color on parchment (5.9:1).

tokens.name: zone-side-light
tokens.usage: Side Quests zone head on the wood board (5.2:1).

tokens.name: cal-event
tokens.usage: Calendar: events, always with the ● circle marker. 5.2:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: cal-deadline
tokens.usage: Calendar: quest deadlines, with the ■ square marker. 5.1:1.

tokens.name: cal-birthday
tokens.usage: Calendar: birthdays, with the ▲ triangle marker. Marker and chip edge only — 3.5:1, not text.

tokens.name: cal-glossary
tokens.usage: Calendar: dated Glossary notes, with the ◆ diamond marker. Marker and chip edge only — 3.7:1, not text.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Classical h1. Display text may drop to the 400 cut.

styles.name: title-sheet
styles.usage: Quest title in the edit sheet; the brand name in the sidebar (25px).

styles.name: week-num
styles.usage: Day numbers in the week strip; with tabular numerals.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Classical h4; dialog titles; the Complete button label.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Card and quest-note titles; dashed add buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default reading text in q-ink. The app shell sets 1.5.
styles.sample: Ticking the last step offers to complete the quest.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Card bodies, fight names, compact lists.

styles.name: meta-text
styles.usage: Meta lines, pills, quick-add chips, legends — in color-accent-800, tabular numerals.

styles.name: label-text
styles.usage: Field and axis labels, weekday heads: uppercase, color-accent-700.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions, note footers, calendar chips.

tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, card gaps, table cells, paragraph-to-heading.

tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing, nav vertical padding.

tokens.usage: Dialog padding, section rules, nav gap.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level separation.

tokens.usage: Quest notes, tile notes, calendar chips — paper edges.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs.
